name: com.corbino50211.bimos-active-ragdolls
description: Physics-driven active ragdoll NPCs for Unity VR, built to sit alongside the BIMOS player rig. NPCs walk, balance, fight and die as continuously simulated ragdolls: joint motors drive every limb toward an animated/procedural puppet pose, bounded balance and propulsion forces keep them upright, and every body part reacts to pushes, punches, bullets and stabs at all times.

samples.description: Mouse/keyboard test player (shoot, shove, stab-test, respawn) so the NPCs can be exercised without a headset. Requires the Input System package (already a BIMOS dependency).
